rule: Generate footage without a logo. Apply a supplied canonical logo as a deterministic post-production overlay; do not ask an image or video model to reproduce it. Remote URLs are deliberately not used because they are not durable production assets.

darkFootage.label: Light wordmark for dark footage
darkFootage.placement: bottom-left, small watermark, clear space equal to the wordmark cap height

lightFootage.label: Dark wordmark for light footage
lightFootage.placement: bottom-left, small watermark, clear space equal to the wordmark cap height
